messages:
sophia: Quick follow-up from the postmortem 3 repeated mid-stream cutoffs and timeouts. We need a compact remediation plan and explicit owners: resume token behavior, keepalive tuning, client retries, and observability. Can folks take parts?

noah: I'll own server resume semantics. Plan: attach `resume_token` to final chunk, don't GC token for 90s, and only close connections after final-ack. Spike + unit tests by EOD Thu.

ben: I'll pick up client retry/resume. Proposal: try `X-Stream-Resume` within 60s using jittered exponential backoff, cap to 3 attempts, then fallback to full restart. I'll add debug header `X-Client-Stream-Stage` for canary. PR by Fri.

sophia: Observability? Need clear metrics to prove a fix.

oncall-sre: I'll do runbook and alerts. Suggested metrics: `stream_partial_count`, `stream_resume_attempts_total`, `stream_resume_success_total`, `stream_last_chunk_gap_ms`. Pager if partial_rate > 0.15% AND p95 gap > 2s for 10m. Runbook update by Mon.

noah: For logs I'll add: `INFO stream_resume token=%s stream_id=%s age_ms=%d resumed=%t`. Also push a sampled debug payload when resume fails. Canary region: staging -> us-west-2.

ben: Client rollout plan: feature-flag 2% -> 20% -> 100%. Will include integration tests simulating metadata-only frames and abrupt socket closes.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Created ticket INF-5200: "stream-resume-and-observability-epic". Assignees: noah, ben, oncall-sre.

sophia: Acceptance criteria: canary shows partial_response_rate < 0.03% and resume_success_rate >= 98% for 48h. Also logs must show resume_token present in >99% of candidate connections.

oncall-sre: Alert thresholds I'll add to Grafana: early notify at 0.05% for 5m, page at 0.2% for 10m or resume_fail_rate > 8% for 15m. Will attach playbook steps (increase keepalive, switch to resume-capable pool, rollback).

noah: Implementation notes: resume token entropy 128 bits, TTL in metadata `resume_ttl_ms=90000`, scrub tokens after TTL. Will add metric `resume_token_age_ms` to help tune TTL.

ben: I'll include a small client header `X-Trace-Stream` to correlate server logs with client traces.

sophia: Let's run 10m daily sync for the week and update INF-5200 with PRs/dashboards/canary results. Thanks all :rocket:
